message.content: {"count":3,"rationale":"Block fileServer:lateralMovement, domainAdmin:privilegeEscalation, and hypervisor:privilegeEscalation. Blocking fileServer also disables secretsManager, so all four parents of the target become unreachable. For minimality, the direct supplychain → tokenCache → fileServer → codeRepo route requires blocking one of its three non-entry steps. None affects the domainAdmin → mailArchive or hypervisor → dbReplica routes. Those two routes cannot both be disabled by any single remaining step: hypervisor can be reached through either dbLogin or vpnSession, avoiding any individual prerequisite of domainAdmin. Thus at least three blocks are necessary."}
